title: Elicitation
excerpt: Elicitation The elicitation feature allows servers to request additional information from users during interactions. This feature enables more dynamic and interactive AI experiences, making it easier to gather necessary context before executing tasks. The protocol supports two modes of elicitation: Form (In Band) : The server requests structured data (strings, numbers, Booleans, enums) which the client collects via a form interface and returns to the server.
